messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG,

Thank you for your letter and for setting out your position.

By the figures you gave us - LCI-C +2.7% at 30% of your cost, PPI-C241 +6.5% at 24% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +2.4%, not the 9.5% you ask for. Your letter gives us only 51 days of notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01, ctr:4600070110). Our contract requires 90 days. The German labour cost index for manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

The data does not support your price as it stands.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 131.25 per unit, payment 90 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 129.72 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option C: EUR 130.08 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We look forward to your revised offer.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

We thank you for your precise review of our indices and for your flexibility in maintaining the 2026-11-01 effective date in your proposed options. Please understand that as a privately held foundry, we treat our detailed cost breakdowns as strictly confidential and must respectfully decline to share them. While your calculation of the weighted index effect is mathematically correct, it does not capture our full cost exposure; however, in recognition of our long-standing relationship, we concede to EUR 135.80 per unit under 30-day payment terms. 

Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us. For our offer, we state a price of €135.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG,

Thank you for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you.

Your latest offer is still 7.3% above today's price of EUR 126.53. Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 85.2% (sc:70110@2026Q3). German producer prices for electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

We would rather spend our time making good pumps together than exchanging e-mails about cents, so we have tried to make the options below easy to say yes to.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 134.27 per unit, payment 90 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 132.49 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option C: EUR 132.93 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

Which cost elements of this part have actually risen since our last price agreement?

We look forward to your reply and to many more years of good cooperation.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As to the index change and delivery record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We have verified the drop in the power index and the delivery figures you cited, and we take them seriously. While power costs have indeed eased, our labour and material costs have risen significantly since our last agreement, which necessitates this adjustment. 

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

In recognition of our long-standing partnership, we are willing to meet you at EUR 133.10 per unit with 30-day payment terms. Specifically, our offer is a price of €133.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG,

Thank you for your reply and for the steps you have made - we appreciate it.

The agreement covers our full need of 8,150 units a year - about EUR 1,084,765 of business for you.

We are close now; the options below are a fair way to close the remaining gap. We would like to settle this in writing; the options below are our complete proposal.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 136.70 per unit, new price from 2027-04-01, payment 30 days net.
Option B: EUR 132.49 per unit, new price from 2026-11-01, payment 30 days net.
Option C: EUR 133.69 per unit, new price from 2027-01-01, payment 30 days net.

We would be glad to finalise on this basis.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
